description_en: Queries the status of the Internet Border firewall for a pay-as-you-go instance
description_zh: 查询按量付费用户互联网边界开关模块状态
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-postpay-user-internet-status --instance-id cfw_elasticity_public_cn-zsk39m000000 --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePostpayUserInternetStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Firewall instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Status.description_en:
The status of the Internet Border firewall. Valid values:

open: The firewall is enabled.

init: The firewall is being enabled.

closed: The firewall is disabled
Status.description_zh:
云防火墙互联网边界开关模块状态。取值：

open：模块已开启。
init：模块开启中。
closed：模块未开启

UnprotectedDate.description_en: The number of days that the firewall was disabled. This parameter is returned only if the value of the Status parameter is open
UnprotectedDate.description_zh: 未开启防护的天数。仅当模块开启时，该参数有效
